title: [Dash] Bolus registred under treatments but not delivered
symptom: A bolus of 2.80u was registered in treatments and Nightscout but not delivered to the Omnipod Dash pump, causing unexpected blood glucose rise.
cause: The bolus was entered via the 'Treatments' button with the 'Do not bolus, record only' option checked, so it was recorded in the database but not sent to the pump.
fix: No fix was provided; the behavior is not a bug but a feature. The user should be aware that 'Record only' entries are not delivered to the pump.
evidence_quote: After reading the logs, it looks like the entry was added via the 'Treatments' button and the 'Do not bolus, record only' option was checked(see (value=Record)):
